name: Andaz Capital Gate, Abu Dhabi
positioning: Andaz hotel inside Abu Dhabi's Capital Gate, the tower that leans 18 degrees, next to the exhibition centre, with local art throughout
best_for: Travelers attending events at the Abu Dhabi National Exhibition Centre
Architecture and art lovers who want to stay inside a record-holding leaning tower

facts.text: The hotel is set in the Capital Gate tower, which leans 18 degrees.
The hotel is adjacent to ADNEC, the Abu Dhabi National Exhibition Centre.
The tower stands in the Embassies District, just off one of the city's busiest thoroughfares.
The public spaces are filled with ornate Middle Eastern art and decorative motifs, from intricate wooden window adornments to Islamic calligraphy and traditional woven fabrics.
Bags are taken at the entrance, and guests head up to the 18th floor for check-in.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views over the capital.
Every room features eclectic local art and inspired stories.
The King and Twin rooms have a marble bathroom with a walk-in rain shower and a deep-soaking tub.
The Family Room has two interconnecting rooms, one with a king bed and the other with twin beds.
The Lean is the hotel's pool deck, suspended high above the city, with a calm, sunlit setting by day.
Cyan Brasserie blends the charm of a Parisian eatery, with French-rooted cuisine, and the warm hospitality of the Middle East.
The 19th floor is also home to the fitness center and the Rayana Spa, which offers treatments and house rituals.

highlights.text: With its 18-degree incline, the building holds the Guinness World Record for the farthest leaning tower.
The ground floor, called 165 Below, is a permanent gallery space with works by local artists.
The terrace pool is on the 19th floor, with a small lounge area and views.
The Andaz Suite sits at the top of the tower, with floor-to-ceiling windows looking over the Arabian Gulf and a marble bathroom with a whirlpool tub.
Guests get complimentary access to a private beach 10 minutes from the hotel.

considerations.text: The private beach that guests can use is 10 minutes from the hotel rather than on site.
There are no shaded or indoor parking spots, though valet parking is complimentary for resident guests.
WhataHotel notes a business district location with limited nearby attractions.
